verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a first-party Machines REST API for provisioning and managing Apps, Machines and Volumes, plus a full CLI (flyctl) and an experimental flyctl MCP server. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for non-Machines areas (Managed Postgres, billing, org/access management, secrets) documented in the evidence, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Fly Machines REST API provides resources to provision and manage Fly Apps, Fly Machines, and Fly Volumes.
Fly Machines are fast-launching VMs with a simple REST API.
The API you start with is the API you keep.
